name: landing
title: Landing
description: A one-page product site. The hero, feature sections, plan table and FAQ are data in the front page's frontmatter, so the page is edited in YAML, not HTML. Pricing, changelog and privacy pages ride along. No plugins.

demo.tagline: Tide times that fit in a pocket

features: Hero, features, plans and FAQ rendered from frontmatter
Anchor navigation on the one-page home
Three prose subpages: pricing, changelog, privacy
System light and dark with a toggle

sampleContent.purpose: The front page; its frontmatter holds every section
Plan comparison as a Markdown table

notes: The front page's Markdown body, if any, appears as a closing section below the FAQ
